about.title: About KVT Jewellers
about.subtitle: Excellence in precious metals since 2018
about.ourStoryDesc1: Established in 2018 by Mr. Thangadurai Venkatraman, KVT Jewellers has been a trusted name in the Malaysian jewelry industry. We specialize in retail and wholesale of gold jewelry and bullion, offering premium quality products to our valued customers.
about.ourStoryDesc2: Our commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction has made us a preferred choice for those seeking quality gold and silver products. With years of experience in the precious metals market, we understand the value of trust, authenticity, and superior craftsmanship.
